summary: Boat choice now picks the scheduled boat with the best historical yt/angler rate for that class (computed from observed trips, min sample size) instead of just the most recently active one.
describe: Reactive momentum, no weather. Tracks yellowtail kept+released per angler over the last 2-3 days separately for each trip class (half day AM/PM, three-quarter, full day, twilight, overnight, 1.5-day), so a hot class is not diluted by dead ones. At 21:00, books tomorrow's bookable cheap-class offer with the best positive trailing rate. At 16:00, books today's twilight trip whenever any cheap class shows a positive rate (twilight never costs PTO), and books the better of overnight/1.5-day when the premium trailing rate is positive. Weekday PTO for the date 14 days out is committed whenever the best trailing rate across all classes is positive, keeping a 1-day reserve. Every booking is checked against the actual sailing schedule for that class and fishing day and against budget. Among the boats actually scheduled, picks whichever has the best all-time yellowtail-per-angler rate for that class (recomputed from observed trips each tick, minimum sample size required), falling back to the most-recently-active scheduled boat if no boat has enough data. A run of skunks stops booking naturally since every signal only looks a few days back.
